WITH HighSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, GSoffered, GSserved
  FROM schools
  WHERE NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND StatusType = 'Operating'
    AND GSoffered LIKE '%12%'  -- Schools that offer grade 12
),
ServingGrade12 AS (
  -- Filter high schools that actually serve grade 12 (means GSserved includes 12)
  SELECT CDSCode, School, GSserved
  FROM HighSchools
  WHERE GSserved LIKE '%12%'
),
SATCounts AS (
  -- Sum SAT test takers by school
  SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS total_takers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
),
NoSATTakers AS (
  -- Join schools with SAT counts, treat no SAT records as zero takers
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.GSserved, IFNULL(sc.total_takers, 0) AS total_takers
  FROM ServingGrade12 s
  LEFT JOIN SATCounts sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
  WHERE IFNULL(sc.total_takers, 0) = 0
),
GradeRank AS (
  -- Assign rank based on earliest grade served considering PK < K < 1 < 2 < ...
  SELECT CDSCode, School, GSserved,
    CASE
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%PK%' THEN 0
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%K%' THEN 1
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%1%' THEN 2
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%2%' THEN 3
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%3%' THEN 4
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%4%' THEN 5
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%5%' THEN 6
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%6%' THEN 7
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%7%' THEN 8
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%8%' THEN 9
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%9%' THEN 10
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%10%' THEN 11
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%11%' THEN 12
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%12%' THEN 13
      ELSE 100 -- Unknown or no grades found
    END AS LowestGradeRank
  FROM NoSATTakers
),
MinGradeRank AS (
  SELECT MIN(LowestGradeRank) AS MinRank
  FROM GradeRank
)
SELECT School, GSserved
FROM GradeRank, MinGradeRank
WHERE LowestGradeRank = MinRank
ORDER BY School ASC
;

  SELECT h.CDSCode, h.School, h.GSserved

  LEFT JOIN HighSchoolsWithSAT s ON h.CDSCode = s.cds
  WHERE s.TotalTestTakers IS NULL OR s.TotalTestTakers = 0
),
GradeRank AS (
  SELECT 'preschool' AS Grade, 0 AS Rank UNION ALL
  SELECT 'k', 1 UNION ALL
  SELECT '1', 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT '2', 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT '3', 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT '4', 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT '5', 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT '6', 7 UNION ALL
  SELECT '7', 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT '8', 9 UNION ALL
  SELECT '9', 10 UNION ALL
  SELECT '10', 11 UNION ALL
  SELECT '11', 12 UNION ALL
  SELECT '12', 13
),
SplitGrades AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, GSserved,
    TRIM(substr(GSserved, 1, INSTR(GSserved, '-') - 1)) AS LowGrade
  FROM FilteredHighSchools
),
LowGradeRanked AS (

)

WITH grade_order AS (  -- Define grade precedence for comparison
  SELECT 'P' AS grade, 1 AS precedence UNION ALL
  SELECT 'K', 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT '1', 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT '2', 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT '3', 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT '4', 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT '5', 7 UNION ALL
  SELECT '6', 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT '7', 9 UNION ALL
  SELECT '8', 10 UNION ALL
  SELECT '9', 11 UNION ALL
  SELECT '10', 12 UNION ALL
  SELECT '11', 13 UNION ALL
  SELECT '12', 14
),

-- Filter California state special schools and extract starting grade from GSoffered
state_special_schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, GSoffered, 
    SUBSTR(GSoffered, 1, 1) AS start_grade
  FROM schools
  WHERE State = 'CA' AND FundingType = 'State Special School'
),

-- Join grade precedence to get ordering
schools_with_grade_order AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.GSoffered, s.start_grade, g.precedence
  FROM state_special_schools s
  JOIN grade_order g ON s.start_grade = g.grade
),

-- Select the school starting enrollment latest (max precedence) with enrollment count
max_start_grade AS (
  SELECT MAX(precedence) AS max_precedence
  FROM schools_with_grade_order
),

-- Schools that have maximum start grade precedence
candidates AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM schools_with_grade_order s
  JOIN max_start_grade m ON s.precedence = m.max_precedence
),

-- K-12 enrollment and SAT takers from satscores
sat_enroll AS (
  SELECT cds, enroll12, NumTstTakr
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'Overall'
),

-- Combine candidates with SAT info, considering SAT takers as 0 if missing
final_candidates AS (
  SELECT c.School, c.start_grade AS Earliest_Grade, COALESCE(s.enroll12, 0) AS K12_Enrollment, 
    COALESCE(s.NumTstTakr, 0) AS SAT_Takers
  FROM candidates c
  LEFT JOIN sat_enroll s ON s.cds = c.CDSCode
)

-- Final selection re-applied order: largest enrollment, then alphabetically
SELECT School, Earliest_Grade, K12_Enrollment, SAT_Takers
FROM final_candidates
ORDER BY K12_Enrollment DESC, School ASC
LIMIT 1;

    r95.district_id,

)

  FROM FilteredLoans f

),
LoanBalances AS (
  -- For each loan, find the transaction on the loan approval day with the highest trans_id
  SELECT l.loan_id, t.balance
  FROM LoansWithAccounts l
  JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id AND l.approval_date = t.date
  WHERE t.trans_id = (
    SELECT MAX(trans_id)
    FROM trans t2
    WHERE t2.account_id = t.account_id AND t2.date = l.approval_date
  )
),
TopLoans AS (
  SELECT l.loan_id, l.district_id, l.approval_date, l.approved_amount, b.balance

)

    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'Gold'
),

    SELECT district_id, A3 AS district_name, A4 AS region
    FROM district
),

LoanCounts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),

TransSummary AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),

ExternalCounterparties AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bank || '-' || account) AS external_counterparties_count
    FROM trans
    WHERE bank IS NOT NULL AND bank <> 'na'
    GROUP BY account_id
),

FinalResult AS (
    SELECT
        ga.account_id,
        di.district_name,
        di.region,
        COALESCE(ts.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
        COALESCE(ts.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
        COALESCE(lc.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
        COALESCE(ec.external_counterparties_count, 0) AS external_counterparties_count
    FROM GoldAccounts ga
    LEFT JOIN DistrictInfo di ON ga.district_id = di.district_id
    LEFT JOIN TransSummary ts ON ga.account_id = ts.account_id
    LEFT JOIN LoanCounts lc ON ga.account_id = lc.account_id
    LEFT JOIN ExternalCounterparties ec ON ga.account_id = ec.account_id
)

SELECT
    account_id,
    district_name,
    region,
    total_received,
    total_withdrawn,
    loan_count,
    external_counterparties_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties_count DESC) AS rank
FROM FinalResult
ORDER BY rank, account_id;

WITH tabor_accounts AS (

  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN disp disp ON a.account_id = disp.account_id AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE d.district_id = 1 -- Assuming Tabor branch is district_id=1
    AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
cards_by_account AS (
  SELECT disp.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM card
  JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
  WHERE card.issued <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY disp.account_id
),
loans_by_account AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
         MAX(CASE
           WHEN status = 'B' THEN 3 -- defaulted
           WHEN status IN ('C','D') THEN 2 -- repaying
           WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 -- paid off
           ELSE 0
         END) AS max_status_rank
  FROM loan
  WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
loans_label AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         CASE
           WHEN loan_count = 0 THEN 'no loan'
           WHEN max_status_rank = 3 THEN 'defaulted'
           WHEN max_status_rank = 2 THEN 'repaying'
           ELSE 'paid off'
         END AS loan_standing
  FROM loans_by_account
),
trans_1997 AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'cash_withdrawal') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
         MAX(balance) AS peak_balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE date >= '1997-01-01' AND date <= '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
peak_ranked AS (
  SELECT account_id, peak_balance,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS rank
  FROM trans_1997
)
SELECT
  t.account_id,
  t.opened_date,
  t.gender,
  (strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') - strftime('%Y', t.birth_date) -
   (strftime('%m-%d', '1996-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', t.birth_date))
  ) AS age_at_1996_12_31,
  COALESCE(cb.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
  COALESCE(lb.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
  COALESCE(ll.loan_standing, 'no loan') AS loan_standing,
  COALESCE(t97.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count,
  COALESCE(t97.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
  COALESCE(t97.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
  COALESCE(t97.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance,
  COALESCE(pr.rank, 0) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM tabor_accounts t
LEFT JOIN cards_by_account cb ON t.account_id = cb.account_id
LEFT JOIN loans_by_account lb ON t.account_id = lb.account_id
LEFT JOIN loans_label ll ON t.account_id = ll.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans_1997 t97 ON t.account_id = t97.account_id
LEFT JOIN peak_ranked pr ON t.account_id = pr.account_id
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, t.account_id
LIMIT 1000;

    Patient.ID AS Patient_ID,
    Patient.Birthday,
    Laboratory.Date AS TestDate,
    Laboratory.RNP
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
  WHERE Patient.Diagnosis LIKE '%thrombosis%'
    AND Laboratory.RNP != 'negative'
),

ParsedRNP AS (
  SELECT
    Patient_ID,
    Birthday,
    TestDate,
    CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) AS RNPValue
  FROM FilteredLaboratory
  WHERE RNP GLOB '[0-9]*'
),

FilteredAge AS (
  SELECT
    Patient_ID,
    RNPValue,
    STRFTIME('%Y', TestDate) - STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS AgeYears
  FROM ParsedRNP
  WHERE RNPValue >= 64
)

SELECT MIN(AgeYears) AS YoungestAge
FROM FilteredAge;

  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID AS patient_id, Patient.SEX

  WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5

  FROM Creatinine_Out_Of_Range

  COALESCE(o.out_of_range_patients, 0) AS out_of_range_patients,
